title: AI teacher resources route
body: AI Teacher Resources | Games, Lessons & Projects Skip to main content AI-assisted classroom work Original activities, games, assignments, and projects. AI Teacher Resources. Original games, assignments, projects, and lessons for classrooms where AI can help deal prompts, branch paths, track evidence, and keep the thread. Outside-link collections live in Teacher Resources; this page holds built activities. Type Original AI-assisted teaching activities. Holds Games, assignments, projects, lessons. Use Teacher-facing activities with clear classroom roles. Method Evidence, play, writing, and guided discussion. Entries 2 No activities match. Clear search and filters Activities Search and type filters need JavaScript; the complete activities remain readable below. game DENOTE High school + adult · ESL and ELA, philosophy of language The AI deals a pair of concepts to two teams, and they race to chain each one down through its own meaning. The first team to reach the floor or close the circle with clean moves wins. How to run it Deal one level-appropriate concept to each team. Each team defines its concept without using the word or its root. Lift one word from that definition and define it the same way; keep descending. Finish at a word too plain to simplify or at a clean loop back to an earlier word. Allow challenges for smuggled roots, reused words, or premature loops. Where AI helps The AI deals paired concepts, tracks both chains, judges challenges, and calls the first clean finish. game Monster Battle Elementary, ages 6 to 10 · ESL and ELA, descriptive language Two children invent monsters and duel through description. There are no hit points; the richer and more vivid telling wins. How to run it Each child invents and richly describes a monster. The AI sets an age-appropriate arena. Players alternate a described move and a response for three exchanges each. The AI presses for sensory detail, narrates the clash, and resolves the winner on storytelling quality. Where AI helps The AI holds the turn sequence, prompts sharper detail, keeps the scene age-right, and judges narrative weight.
